items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I met the man (inaudible) came from England.

ctx.x: Let's start with George Shearing, who made a kind of a --

Well, to me, -- I'm glad you brought that, too. I look at that man and I picture him in two different pictures. When I say two different pictures, I met the man (inaudible) came from England. And I know how he played. When he got here, the man that (unintelligible) at 52nd, where
George used to hang around every night for open to close, was Earl Gardner.
